subject: social_studies
concept: Understanding scarcity: there isn't always enough of everything for everyone, so choices have to be made
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student experiences a simple scenario with a limited supply of a desired item and must decide how to handle it fairly
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a scarcity scenario to a fair way of handling limited supply
exercise.abstract: Student explains why scarcity means people and communities have to make choices

misconception_flags: believes there is always enough of every resource for everyone who wants it

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
